why: The refusals of a browser's two key halves (wave 13s, line 13s, SEC-2): one half without the other; a press another site's page sent to the pairing press, the ask door or the move; and a move of the old cookie that finds nothing to move. No request in this test carries a half of a device key, and none presses pairing, asks or moves. Each is met through its door elsewhere. tests/a-browser-proves-the-person-with-two-halves.test.ts meets oneHalfOfADeviceKey in cases 3 to 5. tests/the-old-cookie-moves-once.test.ts meets nothingToMove in case 2. A press and a move sent with Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site are refused with 403 in case 12 of the first and case 5 of the second; those cases check the status and that nothing was set, and not the code.
